description: 2017 Commodity Flow Survey Public Use File (CFS PUF) is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by US Census. An unofficial version of the 2017 CFS Public use file. The official version can be found here:. This version was kept active to have API access tot he data. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 20 columns, among them DEST_MA, WGT_FACTOR, EXPORT_CNTRY, SHIPMT_DIST_ROUTED, SHIPMT_DIST_GC, SHIPMT_WGHT. The portal shows 2022-01-27 as the last data update. Attribution given: US Census. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
